data_fields.name: ledger_slot_count
data_fields.donor_constant: loaded from GAME_GLOBAL_VARS section, not fixed in code

best_idea: A dialogue node is a function that offers options, a pick runs the chosen node, and an empty option list ends the talk, with reaction tags kept as cosmetic mood only.
decision_why: The node protocol maps well onto zone-data NPC talks, but the blocking loop becomes a server-held node id with verified picks, and reaction tags stay out of the ledger.
acceptance: An NPC with three nodes: picking Tell me more shows that node's options; picking Leave ends the talk; a node that offers nothing ends the talk on the server; a 31st option is rejected with an error to the author; a reaction tag changes only the NPC mood field, never a ledger slot.
